question.question_text: Which event lasted longer, adding paste from a jar and adjusting the cooking settings, or cutting paper and measuring rice?

answer_options.text: Cutting paper and measuring rice took longer
Adding paste from a jar and adjusting the cooking settings took longer
No paste form a jar was added
No paper was cut and no rice was measured
